invariants.statement: The brain tissue is centrally located within the image frame, surrounded by a black background.
invariants.evidence: All 8 reference images show the brain cross-section centered against a uniform black void.

invariants.statement: The brain cross-section exhibits a continuous, roughly oval or circular outer boundary.
invariants.evidence: Every reference image displays a single, connected brain mass with a closed perimeter.

invariants.statement: The image consists of a grayscale palette (black background, gray/white tissue) with no other colors.
invariants.evidence: All 8 images are monochromatic medical scans without color saturation.

invariants.statement: The brain tissue displays a granular, heterogeneous texture with visible internal structures.
invariants.evidence: All 8 images show internal variations in intensity (gray matter/white matter/CSF) rather than a solid uniform block.
